findings.text: This commit changes the verification-target file: it changes the import, rewrites the `VerificationConditions` docstrings, and moves `of_run`/`congr_run`/`violates_required_schema` out of the file. Owner review required. Fix: get the owner's review of the changed verification-target file before release.

The `match` over `Statement` in `SchemaOnly` uses a catch-all `_ => False`, so a new constructor is silently excluded and causes no compile error. Fix: list `beginTransaction`, `commit`, `rollback`, `insert` and `update` as separate `False` cases.

`advance_schemaOnly` is a library lemma that other proofs use (`runSqlFrom_schemaOnly_append` and `runSqlFrom_extends` in `Preservation.lean`), but its docstring has no proof sketch. Fix: add one sentence that says the proof does a case split on the statement and uses the guard to exclude the transaction and literal-write branches.

The new module has no module docstring that gives its reason; the only module comment is the example block at the end. Fix: add a `/-! ... -/` docstring after the imports that says why the schema-only SQL lemmas are separate from `SqlExecution.lean`.
The new module has no module docstring that gives its reason. Fix: add a `/-! ... -/` docstring that says why the proof helpers for the verification target are separate from `Contract.lean`.
